variation: Seated selectorized hip adduction with pads inside thighs; comfortable wide start, squeeze inward, controlled outward return.
camera: Fixed front slight three-quarter showing both inner-thigh pads, hand grips and feet.
equipment: Real hip adduction machine, fixed seat/backrest and handles, two pivoting pad/footrest assemblies, enclosed resistance tower.

beats.label: Set your starting width
beats.cue: Rest inner thighs against pads; grip handles.
beats.pose: Seated supported, knees comfortably wide and bent90degrees, pads against inner thighs.

beats.label: Squeeze inward
beats.cue: Bring knees together against the pads.
beats.pose: Thighs halfway toward midline, feet and pads move with legs.

beats.label: Finish the squeeze
beats.cue: Squeeze inner thighs without lifting your hips.
beats.pose: Knees nearly together with pads between; back and pelvis supported.

beats.label: Control the closed position
beats.cue: Keep your back supported and core braced.

beats.label: Open slowly
beats.cue: Let knees open slowly against resistance.

beats.label: Return under tension
beats.cue: Reach your starting width without relaxing completely.
